notes.title: PhotonVERSE release
notes.notes:
First of all we would like to thank you for buying our game. 
PhotonVERSE is a challenging but fair game.
You will encounter 100 stages through 10 neon themed worlds.
Every world has something unique that makes that simple game very interesting.  
To unlock the Time attack and Jump attack modes you will need first to beat the game at the free play mode which is the main mode.
We also add 8 skins for you to unlock after you beat the first mode.
You will notice a weekly challenge button. This mode is a very challenging stage that every week will be rotated with a new unique one.
We are planning to expand the game with free minor and major updates. 
In the next major update we are planning to add the "Speedrun Mode"
Enjoy our game and the original Synthwave music that accompanies it.
